ESSENTIAL TRAVEL TIPS

Taj Mahal Practical Visitor Guide 2026

Everything you need to know before visiting: ticket booking, Friday rules, luggage lockers, dress codes, and avoiding common tourist scams.

1. Opening Hours & Friday Closure

The Taj Mahal opens 30 minutes before sunrise and closes 30 minutes before sunset. CRITICAL: The Taj Mahal is CLOSED EVERY FRIDAY for general visitors. Make sure your travel itinerary does not schedule a Taj visit on a Friday.

2. Entry Ticket Prices (2026 Official ASI Rates)

  • Foreign Tourists: ₹1,100 standard entry + ₹200 for main dome access (Total ₹1,300 / approx $16 USD). Includes shoe covers and a 500ml water bottle.
  • SAARC & BIMSTEC Citizens: ₹540 standard entry + ₹200 main dome (Total ₹740).
  • Indian Citizens: ₹50 standard entry + ₹200 main dome (Total ₹250).
  • Children below 15 years: Free entry (Indian and International).

3. Prohibited Items Inside Monument

Strict security checks are in place. The following items are NOT allowed inside: tripods, camera gimbals/stabilizers, drones, electronic chargers/cables, knives, lighters, cigarettes, chewing gum, and large backpacks. Safe cloakrooms/lockers are available at both East and West gates.
